worlds.title: 四天抵达月球
worlds.posterTitle: 四天抵达月球
worlds.posterHook: 按下点火：真实比例的地球与月球、真实轨道力学，从发射台一路飞进环月轨道。

en.title: Four Days to the Moon
en.posterTitle: Four Days to the Moon
en.posterHook: Press ignite: true-scale Earth and Moon, real orbital mechanics, from the launch pad all the way into lunar orbit.

worlds.title: 掠过黑洞时看见的扭曲星空
worlds.posterTitle: 掠过黑洞边缘的星空
worlds.posterHook: 从遥远星海靠近，看光被拉成灿烂圆环；越过最近点，再回头看它缩成一粒金色星光。

en.title: The distorted sky seen on a black-hole flyby
en.posterTitle: The sky on a flyby past a black hole
en.posterHook: Approach through a sea of stars, hover by a blazing ring, then fly past and watch the black hole recede to a golden point.

worlds.title: 一条迭代公式控制一万个点的运动
worlds.posterTitle: 参数变化让点云形成周期与混沌运动
worlds.posterHook: 纯黑画布上，每个点只是 sin 与 cos；合在一起却像深海里一只缓缓呼吸的白影。换系数、拧形变，看它从水母变成脊骨。

en.title: One iterative formula controls the motion of ten thousand points
en.posterTitle: Parameter changes produce periodic and chaotic point-cloud motion
en.posterHook: On pure black, each point is only sin and cos; together they look like a white silhouette breathing in the deep. Swap coefficients, turn morph, watch jellyfish become spine.

worlds.title: 单粒子逐个穿过双缝形成干涉条纹
worlds.posterTitle: 一颗粒子会和「自己」发生干涉吗？
worlds.posterHook: 先看波的叠加，再逐个发射粒子累积条纹；打开「观测路径」，亲手让干涉当场消失。

en.title: Single particles build an interference pattern at a double slit
en.posterTitle: Will a particle interfere with "itself"?
en.posterHook: First watch the superposition of waves, then launch particles one by one to accumulate stripes; open the "observation path" and make the interference disappear on the spot.

worlds.title: 一齐放开，一排摆自己走出波浪
worlds.posterTitle: 一排摆在不同周期中形成波浪
worlds.posterHook: 同样的起点，为什么它们会先变成波浪，再乱成一片，最后又整齐回来？

en.title: Release them together and watch a row of pendulums walk themselves into waves
en.posterTitle: Pendulums with different periods form a travelling wave
en.posterHook: Same starting point—why do they first turn into waves, then into chaos, then line up again?

worlds.title: 相差 0.1° 的双摆轨迹
worlds.posterTitle: 差 0.1° 的两次放手，为什么结局完全不同？
worlds.posterHook: 拖摆球设定初始角，释放后看紫色影子摆（仅差 0.1°）多久与主摆彻底分叉。

en.title: Double-pendulum paths starting 0.1° apart
en.posterTitle: Why are the two letting gos with a difference of 0.1° completely different endings?
en.posterHook: Drag the pendulum ball to set the initial angle. After releasing it, see how long it takes for the purple shadow pendulum (with a difference of only 0.1°) to completely diverge from the main pendulum.

worlds.title: 萤火虫群体同步闪烁
worlds.posterTitle: 萤火虫会逐渐同步闪烁
worlds.posterHook: 一整片微光，怎么突然一起亮？

en.title: Collective synchronization in flashing fireflies
en.posterTitle: Fireflies gradually synchronize their flashes
en.posterHook: How does a whole field of tiny lights suddenly flash together?

worlds.title: 金属盐在溶液中长成矿物花园
worlds.posterTitle: 金属盐落下，矿物花园开始生长
worlds.posterHook: 沉淀膜在渗透压下膨胀、破裂，有时反复重封，把无生命的盐长成彩色中空管。
worlds.topicLabel: 化学自组织 · 沉淀与渗透

en.title: Metal salts grow into a mineral garden in solution
en.posterTitle: Drop a Metal Salt. Watch a Mineral Garden Grow.
en.posterHook: Osmotic pressure swells and ruptures a precipitate membrane; sometimes it reseals, growing lifeless salt into colored hollow tubes.

worlds.title: 神经网络通过调整权重学习分类
worlds.posterTitle: 神经网络用误差反向调整权重
worlds.posterHook: 换数据集、加深网络、改学习率——看决策边界怎样一点点贴上数据。

en.title: A neural network learns classification by adjusting weights
en.posterTitle: A neural network uses error to update its weights
en.posterHook: Swap datasets, deepen the net, change the learning rate — watch the decision boundary ease onto the data.

worlds.title: 逆运动学根据末端位置计算机械臂关节
worlds.posterTitle: 末端目标位置决定各关节转角
worlds.posterHook: 拖住发光的手爪任意挪动——FABRIK 迭代像把绳子拉直再一节一节装回去；关节限位、肘上肘下双解、够不着就伸直指向，全是真的。

en.title: Inverse kinematics solves robot joints from an end position
en.posterTitle: An end-effector target determines each joint angle
en.posterHook: Drag the glowing gripper anywhere — FABRIK iterates like pulling a rope straight and reattaching it link by link. Joint limits, elbow-up and elbow-down branches, and an honest straight reach for what it cannot touch: all real.

worlds.title: 此刻，整座太阳系
worlds.posterTitle: 八大行星此刻都在哪里？
worlds.posterHook: 任选一天，点任意行星跟拍：此刻它们各自在哪条轨道上。

en.title: The solar system, right now
en.posterTitle: Where are the eight planets right now?
en.posterHook: Pick any day and follow any planet: see where each one sits on its orbit right now.

worlds.title: 三颗星，能跳出这么多完美的舞吗？
worlds.posterTitle: 三颗星，能跳出这么多完美的舞吗？
worlds.posterHook: 先看见离开地面的空间周期解。名解、蝴蝶和 8 字贴在一个平面上；2025 年的三维解会跳起来。点开一条，也可以亲手把它拧散。

en.title: Can three stars dance in so many perfect patterns?
en.posterTitle: Can three stars dance in so many perfect patterns?
en.posterHook: Spatial periodic orbits leave the plane first. Named dances, butterflies, and the figure-eight stay flat; the 2025 three-dimensional solutions lift off. Open one, or nudge it until it falls apart.

worlds.title: 引力助推改变飞船的速度
worlds.posterTitle: 飞船如何不烧燃料，向行星「借」速度？
worlds.posterHook: 选择后方或前方掠过行星，亲眼看 Δv 为正还是为负；再切到旋转参考系，找引力刚好抵消的 5 个点。

en.title: A gravity assist changes a spacecraft’s speed
en.posterTitle: How can a spacecraft "borrow" speed from the planet without burning fuel?
en.posterHook: Choose to fly behind or in front of the planet and see with your own eyes whether Δv is positive or negative; then switch to the rotating reference frame and find 5 points where the gravity just cancels out.

worlds.title: 曼德勃罗集边界的无限细节
worlds.posterTitle: 迭代公式生成自相似的分形边界
worlds.posterHook: 一个公式画出的宇宙：黑色是永远逃不出的点，彩色是逃逸快慢。放大边界，海马谷与螺旋层层展开——相似，却永不重复。

en.title: Infinite detail along the Mandelbrot set boundary
en.posterTitle: An iterative formula produces a self-similar fractal boundary
en.posterHook: One formula paints a universe: black means trapped forever, color means how fast you escape. Zoom the boundary—seahorse valleys and spirals unfold, similar yet never the same.

worlds.title: 猜错起点，答案会跳到另一边
worlds.posterTitle: 每个像素都在猜同一个方程的答案
worlds.posterHook: 用牛顿法从每个像素出发解 z³−1=0：颜色表示落到哪个解，白线是修正路径。

en.title: Guess from the wrong start, and the answer jumps to another side
en.posterTitle: Every pixel is guessing the answer to the same equation
en.posterHook: Solve z³−1=0 from every pixel with Newton’s method: color shows which root you land on; the white line is the path of corrections.

worlds.title: 四个参数迭代生成 Clifford 吸引子
worlds.posterTitle: Clifford 映射形成确定性的点云结构
worlds.posterHook: Clifford 吸引子：每一步只是 sin 与 cos 的交错；十万次之后，翅膀、丝带与暗涡在纯黑里浮现。

en.title: Four parameters generate a Clifford attractor
en.posterTitle: The Clifford map forms a deterministic point cloud
en.posterHook: Clifford attractor: each step is only interlaced sin and cos; after a hundred thousand steps, wings, ribbons, and dark eddies appear on pure black.

worlds.title: 卡库亚针问题的最小转向区域
worlds.posterTitle: 单位线段可以在任意小面积内转向
worlds.posterHook: 最笨的办法是原地转一圈；更聪明的办法是贴着一条三尖形轨道滑过去。答案是：地方可以几乎为零——但再小也不能瘪成一条线。

en.title: The minimum turning region in the Kakeya needle problem
en.posterTitle: A unit segment can turn inside a region of arbitrarily small area
en.posterHook: The clumsy way is to spin in place; a smarter way is to slide along a three-cusped track. The area can shrink to almost nothing—but it still cannot flatten into a single line.

worlds.title: 状态轨迹形成奇异吸引子
worlds.posterTitle: 公式迭代出的奇异吸引子
worlds.posterHook: 六套方程各自规定「下一刻往哪走」；光点跟着跑，久了留下双翼、螺旋与空心球壳。

en.title: State trajectories form strange attractors
en.posterTitle: Strange attractors generated by iterated equations
en.posterHook: Six equation families each say where the state goes next; points follow the rules and leave wings, spirals, and hollow shells.

worlds.title: 涡旋从流体扰动中产生并消散
worlds.posterTitle: 搅动流体时形成的涡旋
worlds.posterHook: 在画布上拖动鼠标或手指，实时搅动 GPU 流体——彩色染料在涡旋中拉伸、卷曲、扩散。

en.title: Vortices form and dissipate after a fluid is disturbed
en.posterTitle: The vortices formed by stirring a fluid
en.posterHook: Drag your mouse or finger across the canvas to stir GPU fluid in real time—colorful dye stretches, curls, and diffuses in vortices.

worlds.title: 电场线勾出看不见的力
worlds.posterTitle: 看不见的电场，为什么能用线画出来？
worlds.posterHook: 在画布上放置正负电荷，实时看电力线弯曲、叠加；拖动电荷，场线像活物一样跟随变形。

en.title: Field lines trace the shape of an invisible electric force
en.posterTitle: Why can an invisible electric field be drawn with lines?
en.posterHook: Place positive and negative charges on the canvas and watch field lines bend and superimpose in real time; drag charges and the lines follow like living things.

worlds.title: 看不见的磁力线
worlds.posterTitle: 铁屑排出磁场的形状
worlds.posterHook: 拖动磁铁，青色与琥珀色的场线重新组织；铁屑像微型指南针，自己排成花纹。

en.title: Invisible magnetic lines
en.posterTitle: Iron filings trace the shape of a magnetic field
en.posterHook: Drag a magnet and cyan–amber field lines reorganize; iron filings act like tiny compasses and line themselves into a pattern.

worlds.title: 旋转圆叠加出方波与周期曲线
worlds.posterTitle: 傅里叶级数把周期信号分解为正弦波
worlds.posterHook: 增减谐波项数，看圆链末端如何一步步描出方波；还可以随手画一条线，让它现场分解。

en.title: Rotating circles combine into square waves and periodic curves
en.posterTitle: Fourier series decompose periodic signals into sine waves
en.posterHook: Increase or decrease the number of harmonic terms to see how the end of the circular chain draws a square wave step by step; you can also draw a line and have it decomposed on the spot.

worlds.title: 铁磁流体
worlds.posterTitle: 磁铁一靠近，黑色液体为什么长出尖刺？
worlds.posterHook: 磁铁一靠近，黑色液体就长出尖刺。

en.title: Ferrofluid
en.posterTitle: Why does black liquid grow spikes when a magnet comes close?
en.posterHook: Bring a magnet close, and black liquid grows a crown of spikes.

worlds.title: 薄膜干涉形成肥皂泡彩色条纹
worlds.posterTitle: 肥皂泡通过薄膜干涉呈现彩色条纹
worlds.posterHook: 薄膜变厚变薄，彩虹跟着滑动；液体往下排，颜色也一起走。

en.title: Thin-film interference colors a soap bubble
en.posterTitle: Thin-film interference gives soap bubbles their colors
en.posterHook: As the film thickens or thins, the rainbow slides; as liquid drains down, the colours move with it.

worlds.title: 泳池焦散光纹
worlds.posterTitle: 泳池底部不断移动的焦散光纹
worlds.posterHook: 为什么泳池底下的光一直在游？

en.title: Caustic light patterns in a pool
en.posterTitle: Moving caustic patterns on a pool floor
en.posterHook: Why does the light on a pool floor keep swimming?

worlds.title: 缩小一片叶隙，让树荫落满一百个太阳
worlds.posterTitle: 树荫下，为什么落着一地小太阳？
worlds.posterHook: 让月球咬住太阳，再缩小叶片缝隙：上百个模糊圆斑会同时变成清晰的金色月牙。

en.title: Narrow one leaf gap and scatter a hundred tiny Suns across the ground
en.posterTitle: Why is the shade beneath a tree filled with tiny Suns?
en.posterHook: Let the Moon bite into the Sun, then narrow the gaps: more than a hundred blurry circles snap into crisp golden crescents.

worlds.title: 闪电沿分叉通道逐步前进
worlds.posterTitle: 闪电沿分叉通道形成锯齿路径
worlds.posterHook: 点击天空召唤闪电，看阶梯先导一步步试探出锯齿路径，回击的光从地面冲向云层。

en.title: Lightning advances through a branching channel
en.posterTitle: Lightning forms a jagged path through branching channels
en.posterHook: Tap the sky to summon a bolt and watch the stepped leader feel its way down while the return stroke races back up.

worlds.title: 温度与湿度决定雪晶形状
worlds.posterTitle: 雪花会长成薄片或针状晶体
worlds.posterHook: 拨动温度与湿度，看同一套六角对称在薄板、枝晶与细针之间切换习性。

en.title: Temperature and humidity shape snow crystals
en.posterTitle: Snow crystals grow as plates or needles
en.posterHook: Scrub temperature and humidity and watch the same six-fold symmetry switch habits among plates, dendrites, and needles.

worlds.title: 鸟群依靠三条局部规则形成统一运动
worlds.posterTitle: 三条局部规则形成鸟群运动
worlds.posterHook: 每只鸟只做三件小事：别撞上、跟着飞、别掉队，整群就会一起转弯。

en.title: Three local rules produce coordinated flocking
en.posterTitle: Three local rules produce flocking behavior
en.posterHook: Each bird does just three things: avoid collisions, follow the flow, and stay with the group. The whole flock turns together.

worlds.title: 植物的螺旋
worlds.posterTitle: 向日葵种子排列成螺旋
worlds.posterHook: 向日葵为什么把种子排成螺线？

en.title: Spirals in plants
en.posterTitle: Sunflower seeds arrange themselves in spirals
en.posterHook: Why do sunflowers arrange their seeds in spirals?
